title: dorstenia dorstenioides
intro: Dorstenia dorstenioides, commonly known as the "African Bloodstone", is a plant species belonging to the family Moraceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions like eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
